key_insight: OptGraph turns past optimization experience into a typed graph so an LLM can retrieve structured, error-aware context for better evolutionary optimization and refinement.
engineering_relevance: The approach improves automated modeling and verification without parameter tuning, making it attractive for reusable optimization pipelines in scientific and engineering workflows.
method: Builds a typed graph of reusable experience linking modeling patterns, formalization, implementations, and error fixes.
Retrieves graph neighborhoods at inference to enrich context for generation, verification, and iterative refinement.
Updates the knowledge graph from execution traces and verification feedback without LLM fine-tuning.
evidence_signal: On benchmark datasets, OptGraph reports an average exact accuracy 8.9% higher than state-of-the-art prompt-based automated optimization frameworks.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality of graph construction and retrieval, so noisy or incomplete traces could limit robustness.
paper_title: OptGraph: Large Language Models Enhanced Evolutionary Optimization Via Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
